thread:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — I'm exploring an ingress lease retirement approach where we allow leases to enter a 'retiring' phase: server signals client to drain, short-lived read-only resume token is issued, and K/V cache is compacted. Thoughts?
Cheng: How short-lived is 'short-lived'? if it's <30s we might risk midflight invalidations. Also need to consider billing attribution when we handoff partial streams.
Tara: @Cheng +1. Proposal: retiring state = N seconds of soft drain + M seconds hard revoke. Example: soft=45s, hard=300s. Soft keeps read-only resume tokens; hard revokes tokens and releases kvcache.
Sasha: I like soft/hard split. Main tradeoff: longer soft reduces spurious midstream aborts but increases memory + billing tail. We can mitigate by issuing resumable-trace-id and probabilistic KV truncation.
Cheng: What about client backpressure? If we tell clients to drain, some will immediately reconnect and cause thundering herd. Maybe introduce jittered backoff hint in handshake response: `retry-after: rng(50-500ms)`.
Tara: :thumbsup: Also want invariant: no side-effectful request should be resumable unless explicitly idempotent flag present. We should add `x-resume-capability: idempotent|readonly|none` to conn handshake.
Sasha: Agreed. Draft handshake patch:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Upgrade: edge-proxy/1
x-resume-capability: readonly
x-resume-token: abc123-signed(exp=1690123456)
x-retire-window: soft=45 hard=300
```
Cheng: Nice. For rollout: start by honoring token but default to 0 soft window for tier B customers, enable gradually. Need metrics: resume_hits, resume_misses, retire_memory_seconds.
Sasha: I'll add to console dashboard + alert on resume_miss_rate > 1% in 5m. Also need a GC plan for K/V shards: LRU with retention hints from token TTL.
Aj: Quick ops note: when retire-hard fires we should emit event to billing: `stream_tail_ms` so we don't overcharge. Current billing only logs full request duration.
Deploy-bot: deploy/edge-proxy-build #3491 succeeded :white_check_mark:.
Tara: Next steps: Sasha to open small RFC PR with handshake shape + rollout plan; Cheng to add metrics; Aj to propose billing event shape. Aim for canary next week.
Sasha: I'll create PR today and drop link once ready. Thanks all.
